The `test_receive_ready_event_raised` test was failing because the `MODEM_PIPE_EVENT_RECEIVE_READY` event was not being processed before the assertion. This was due to the lack of a sufficient delay after writing to the primary file descriptor.

I have fixed this by adding `k_sleep(TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_OP_DELAY);` after the `write` call in `test_receive_ready_event_raised` at line 158 in `main.c`. This allows enough time for the event to be processed and the `TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_PIPE_EVENT_RRDY_BIT` to be set.

The test suite should now pass.
I am done.
